messages:
alex.miller: Heads-up — planning to apply the gateway egress policy change during the agreed change window (02:00-03:00 UTC). PR #482 is ready.
jamie.ops: Thanks. Can you confirm provider/module version pinning? we had drift after last patch.
sarah.platform: PR includes pins: provider.aws = "4.57.0" and module/vpc_gateway = "v1.3.2". Added release note entry under infra/release-notes.md.
alex.miller: copying terraform plan output here for visibility:
```
# terraform plan
+ aws_route.egress_gateway  (new)
~ aws_security_group.sg_egress  (update)
- aws_network_acl_rule.old_acl  (destroy)
Plan: 1 to add, 1 to change, 1 to destroy.
```
jamie.ops: quick checklist: IAM permissions validated, KMS key access looks good, will watch logs during apply.
deply-bot: deploy-bot: terraform plan by alex.miller at 1769804350: success (no errors)
oncall_dev: oncall:+1 for window. I'll be online for first 30m.
alex.miller: Starting apply in 5m. Pinning tfstate lock to s3://redwood-tfstate/prod with session tag release=v2.9.1
sarah.platform: Noting release flag: rollout=canary 10% traffic for 20m, then 100% if green.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: apply started by alex.miller at 1769804380
jamie.ops: seeing initial control-plane egress through new gateway on staging — latency normal.
alex.miller: Apply finished: 3 resources changed. Pushed release note blurb to the release branch.
sarah.platform: Running smoke tests and IAM audit now.
oncall_dev: Observed spike of 502s from staging services at 1769804980, ~3% error rate.
jamie.ops: rolling back to previous route set. manual rollback initiated by jamie.ops.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollback apply started at 1769805020
alex.miller: Rollback completed. Route and ACL state restored. Creating postmortem and INC-2026-142 for the brief outage.
sarah.platform: Root cause: asymmetric route with new egress policy interacting with downstream NAT; patch in PR #483 to fix ordering and add explicit egress allow to the NAT.
jamie.ops: We'll pin the module to v1.3.2 and add an integration test in CI to catch this. Also adding a note in release notes: DO NOT deploy during heavy cross-region migrations.
alex.miller: plan to re-run plan+apply after tests pass, target window tomorrow same time. Marking release v2.9.1 as blocked until PR #483 merges.
sarah.platform: I'll update the release notes and add the canary checklist and rollback playbook in the PR description.
jamie.ops: thanks all. Good catch. :thumbsup:
